name: Sumeragi Ayaka
source:
Ayaka is the younger daughter of the famous Sumeragi family. Her father work far away from the city and her [url=https://vndb.org/c69164]older brother[/url] too. Her only family in the town was her grandmother[spoiler], but she passed away a year ago[/spoiler].

She was educated as a good family girl. With her character of Tsundere, the mixture of the two personalities gives her a very seductive touch.

She is a bit violent with the peoples she cares. She seems very close to [url=https://vndb.org/c14895]Meta[/url].

[spoiler]In her route, she ran away from her home because she has a serious dispute with her [url=https://vndb.org/c69164]brother[/url]. Because she has no roof for sleep, she is collected by [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url].

Then, they start to share the room in secret because Ayaka is not an official dorm resident and the dormitory forbids two people of different sexes from living in the same room ( for ethical reasons ).

Having run away from home, her bank account is no longer powered. [url=https://vndb.org/c14895]Meta[/url] takes her to a small neighborhood restaurant with [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] and they get to know the owner, a very nice old man.

Ayaka finds a job of "waitress-maid" and the customers, mainly made up of grandfathers, does not stop to tell her that she is too cute ( which embarrasses her enormously ).[/spoiler]
